name: Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires graduating from an eligible program at a DLI with a bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degree — exempt from the field-of-study restriction that applies to non-degree graduates.
This applies to those who applied for a study permit on/after 1 Nov 2024 in a non-degree program — the field of study must map to one of 920 eligible CIP codes linked to long-term labour shortages.

evidence_required.document: Degree/diploma certificate from an eligible program
Transcript confirming full-time enrolment throughout the program

outcome.duration_length: up to 3 years for programs of 2+ years (and for master's degrees regardless of length); shorter programs match program length

notes: FIELD-OF-STUDY REQUIREMENT confirmed as genuinely new and non-trivial: for non-degree graduates who applied for a study permit on/after 1 Nov 2024, the program must map to one of 920 eligible CIP codes linked to long-term labour shortages (per the 25 June 2025 update — 119 fields added, 178 removed, then those 178 re-added 4 July 2025 and remaining eligible until the next update expected early 2026) — a genuinely volatile, mid-update-cycle rule worth flagging as high-risk for staleness. Bachelor's/master's/doctoral graduates and PGWP-eligible flight-school graduates are fully exempt from this restriction. Language requirement to apply: CLB 7 (university grads) / CLB 5 (college grads). Direct feeder into ca_express_entry_cec, the direct-to-PR route that dominates 2026 Express Entry volume — closing Canada's core Journey chain (Student → PGWP → CEC → citizenship).
